configurations.name: Gemma4 FastAPI Agent Server
configurations.description: OpenAI-compatible FastAPI server wrapping Ollama. Manages 6 agents (general, coder, analyst, translator, vision, planner). Requires Ollama running on port 11434.

configurations.name: llama-server (Gemma4 CPU-only)
configurations.description: llama-server b8679 Vulkan, CPU-only (GT 1030 2GB VRAM too small). Text-only Gemma4 GGUF. Use raw /completion endpoint to bypass thinking template.

configurations.name: Ollama Serve
configurations.description: Ollama inference engine. Serves gemma3:1b and deepseek-r1:1.5b. Pinned to CPU cores 2+3 by benchmark script.

configurations.name: Benchmark Runner
configurations.description: Sequential CPU-safe benchmark: Gemma3 1B → DeepSeek-r1 1.5B (Ollama) → Gemma4 E4B (llama-server). Results saved to tests/benchmark_results.json.
